name: metr_point_v0_mask_confidence_110
rationale: The conditioning projection has distinct scalar-value and observed-mask columns (norms 14.44 and 12.66; cosine 0.121). Spatial attention diagnosis finds several heads barely distinguish observed sources from interpolated ones. Increase only the observed-mask column by 10% to strengthen this confidence distinction, retaining the value encoding, noisy-state branch and output head. Test whether excessive reliance on interpolated conditioning causes large calibration errors. This hypothesis is evaluated by frozen paired forward passes, without fitting or gradients.
